"""Extend the original static scope review to the corrected source checkpoint."""
import ast
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

CASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
ROOT = CASE.parents[1]
BASE = "2bff5dcf454bc5230f473237a49939215a60aab2"
C = json.loads((CASE / "plan.json").read_text())["candidate"]

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], cwd=ROOT, text=True)

def declarations(text):
    rows = {}
    def visit(body, prefix=""):
        for node in body:
            if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
                if not node.name.startswith("_"):
                    rows[prefix + node.name] = node
            elif isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
                visit(node.body, prefix + node.name + ".")
    visit(ast.parse(text).body)
    return rows

changes = [row.split("\t") for row in git("diff", "--name-status", BASE, C).splitlines()]
runtime = [row for row in changes if row[-1].endswith(".py") and row[-1].split("/")[0] in ("pharmacophoremt", "pharmacophoremt_features", "pharmacophoremt_results")]
removed, signatures, added = [], [], []
for status, path in runtime:
    old = {} if status == "A" else declarations(git("show", BASE + ":" + path))
    new = {} if status == "D" else declarations(git("show", C + ":" + path))
    removed.extend(path + ":" + name for name in old.keys() - new.keys())
    added.extend(path + ":" + name for name in new.keys() - old.keys())
    for name in old.keys() & new.keys():
        if ast.dump(old[name].args) == ast.dump(new[name].args):
            continue
        expected = copy.deepcopy(old[name].args)
        expected.kwonlyargs.append(ast.arg(arg="skip_digestion"))
        expected.kw_defaults.append(ast.Constant(value=False))
        assert ast.dump(expected) == ast.dump(new[name].args), (path, name)
        signatures.append({"path": path, "declaration": name, "before": ast.unparse(old[name].args), "after": ast.unparse(new[name].args), "change": "Only optional keyword-only skip_digestion=False appended; every prior argument/default/annotation retained."})
assert not removed
assert {(r["path"], r["declaration"]) for r in signatures} == {
    ("pharmacophoremt/modeler/features.py", "get_features"),
}
prior = json.loads((ROOT / "devguide/evidence/release_060_scope_review_20261111.json").read_text())["reviewed_source"]
later_signatures = []
for path, name in (("pharmacophoremt/modeler/features.py", "get_features"), ("pharmacophoremt_features/_payload.py", "FeatureInventoryPayload.from_inventory")):
    old = declarations(git("show", prior + ":" + path))[name]
    new = declarations(git("show", C + ":" + path))[name]
    expected = copy.deepcopy(old.args)
    expected.kwonlyargs.append(ast.arg(arg="skip_digestion"))
    expected.kw_defaults.append(ast.Constant(value=False))
    assert ast.dump(expected) == ast.dump(new.args), (path, name)
    later_signatures.append({"path": path, "declaration": name, "before": ast.unparse(old.args), "after": ast.unparse(new.args)})
features = "pharmacophoremt/modeler/features.py"
before = declarations(git("show", BASE + ":" + features))["get_features"]
after = declarations(git("show", C + ":" + features))["get_features"]
def scientific_body(node):
    body = node.body
    if isinstance(body[0], ast.Expr) and isinstance(body[0].value, ast.Constant) and isinstance(body[0].value.value, str):
        body = body[1:]
    return [ast.dump(statement) for statement in body]
assert scientific_body(before) == scientific_body(after)
unchanged = {}
for path in ("pharmacophoremt/screening/pose_evaluation.py", "pharmacophoremt/validation/metrics.py"):
    before = git("show", BASE + ":" + path).encode()
    after = git("show", C + ":" + path).encode()
    assert before == after
    unchanged[path] = hashlib.sha256(after).hexdigest()
build = json.loads((CASE / "owned_build.json").read_text())
assert build["source_commit"] == "7192041d85c7ca9d724028329ec8f18a4bdc9853"
for path, expected in build["runtime_files_equal"].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected["sha256"]
record = {"schema": "pharmacophoremt.release-060.corrected-scope-review@1",
    "base_tag": "0.5.0", "base": BASE, "reviewed_source": C,
    "prior_static_review": "release_060_scope_review_20261111.json",
    "commit_count": int(git("rev-list", "--count", BASE + ".." + C)),
    "runtime_changes": runtime, "removed_nonprivate_declarations": sorted(removed),
    "changed_existing_declared_signatures": sorted(signatures, key=lambda r: r["path"]),
    "prior_reviewed_source": prior,
    "additive_signature_changes_since_prior_review": later_signatures,
    "new_nonprivate_declarations": sorted(added), "get_features_scientific_body_AST_unchanged": True,
    "unchanged_scientific_owners": unchanged,
    "runtime_bodies_equal_to_existing_owned7192041": len(build["runtime_files_equal"]),
    "observed_owned_version": build["version"],

    "source_checkpoint_accepted": False, "version_tag_or_publication_selected": False,
    "release_notes_review": "Correct the unreleased no-signature-change wording to additive optional expert controls, and include the received prepared-library feature recipe and single-source CI acquisition. Historical0.5.0 notes remain byte-for-byte unchanged.",
    "first_review_attempt": "The first controller wrongly expected from_inventory to be an existing0.5.0 declaration. That class/module is new since0.5.0; the corrected review keeps the one changed existing0.5.0 signature and separately verifies both additive controls against the prior f722b45 scope endpoint. Original failed controller/log are retained; no runtime or assertion semantics are relaxed.",
    "review_script": {"sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "text": Path(__file__).read_text()}}

    json.dump(record, output, indent=2)
